lines.text: Leo, the right person claps when no one else is watching.
lines.caption: the quiet applause

lines.text: Leo, being chosen quietly still counts as being chosen.
lines.caption: quiet is still loud

lines.text: Leo, a crowd is not the same thing as a partner.
lines.caption: fans are not partners

lines.text: Leo, if you have to perform for their love, it is a stage, not a home.
lines.caption: get off the stage

lines.text: Leo, they noticed. They just don't narrate it the way you do.
lines.caption: they saw it

lines.text: Leo, loyalty given to the wrong person is still a loan.
lines.caption: loyalty has interest

lines.text: Leo, stop auditioning for someone who already left the theater.
lines.caption: the show is over

lines.text: Leo, pride kept you safe and it also kept you alone.
lines.caption: pride has a price

lines.text: Leo, the one who matches your warmth will not need a reminder.
lines.caption: warmth finds warmth

lines.text: Leo, drama feels like passion until it costs you sleep.
lines.caption: sleep is romantic too

lines.text: Leo, love that needs an audience leaves when the lights go down.
lines.caption: lights down test

lines.text: Leo, saying you miss them first does not cost you the crown.
lines.caption: text first anyway

lines.text: Leo, generosity is beautiful until it becomes the rent you pay to stay.
lines.caption: stop paying rent

lines.text: Leo, someone who dims you on purpose is telling you who they are.
lines.caption: believe the dimmer

lines.text: Leo, the grand gesture means less than the text that shows up on time.
lines.caption: small things win

lines.text: Leo, apologizing first is not losing. It is leading.
lines.caption: say sorry first

lines.text: Leo, if they only love the spotlight version, introduce the quiet one.
lines.caption: meet the quiet one

lines.text: Leo, wanting to be chosen loudly is fair. Asking for it is allowed.
lines.caption: ask out loud

lines.text: Leo, a jealous reaction is not proof that they care.
lines.caption: jealousy is not proof

lines.text: Leo, your ex was not your last chance at being adored.
lines.caption: more adoration ahead

lines.text: Leo, stop giving front-row seats to people who leave at intermission.
lines.caption: reassign the seats

lines.text: Leo, the right one will not make you compete for the light.
lines.caption: no competing for light

lines.text: Leo, sometimes the bravest scene is walking off stage without a speech.
lines.caption: exit without a speech

lines.text: Leo, attention is cheap. Consistency is the expensive one.
lines.caption: consistency is the flex

lines.text: Leo, they can love you and still not be your fan club.
lines.caption: partner not fan club

lines.text: Leo, give your heart to someone who holds it like it might break.
lines.caption: careful hands only

lines.text: Leo, warmth that only flows one way is a fireplace, not a relationship.
lines.caption: one way warmth

lines.text: Leo, you were never too much. You were with someone who wanted less.
lines.caption: never too much

lines.text: Leo, posting about them will not make them stay.
lines.caption: log off for this

lines.text: Leo, the person worth keeping notices when your roar goes quiet.
lines.caption: they hear the quiet

lines.text: Leo, the applause stops. The work has to keep going anyway.
lines.caption: after the applause

lines.text: Leo, nobody is watching, and that is where the real you gets built.
lines.caption: built in private

lines.text: Leo, your worth does not refresh with the likes.
lines.caption: worth does not refresh

lines.text: Leo, rest is not falling out of the spotlight.
lines.caption: rest is allowed

lines.text: Leo, pride is a heavy coat to wear in summer.
lines.caption: take the coat off

lines.text: Leo, asking for help will not cost you the crown.
lines.caption: the crown stays

lines.text: Leo, the version of you offstage deserves the same love.
lines.caption: love the offstage you

lines.text: Leo, being generous with everyone but yourself is a strange kind of math.
lines.caption: check the math

lines.text: Leo, some days the bravest thing is being ordinary on purpose.
lines.caption: ordinary on purpose

lines.text: Leo, comparison turns every room into a contest you never entered.
lines.caption: you did not enter

lines.text: Leo, confidence that needs a witness is borrowed.
lines.caption: borrowed confidence

lines.text: Leo, the loop ends when you stop checking who saw it.
lines.caption: stop checking views

lines.text: Leo, a quiet win still counts, even with no one there to see it.
lines.caption: quiet wins count

lines.text: Leo, your light does not need to win the room to be real.
lines.caption: light is still light

lines.text: Leo, you can be the main character and still take notes.
lines.caption: main character takes notes

lines.text: Leo, the mirror is not a judge. Stop pleading your case to it.
lines.caption: case dismissed

lines.text: Leo, money spent to look fine is still money gone.
lines.caption: looking fine costs

lines.text: Leo, some of your drama is just tiredness wearing a costume.
lines.caption: go to bed

lines.text: Leo, failure in public is survivable. You have done it before.
lines.caption: still standing

lines.text: Leo, be loyal to your own plans the way you are loyal to your people.
lines.caption: loyal to yourself

lines.text: Leo, starting over is not a downgrade. It is a new opening night.
lines.caption: opening night again

lines.text: Leo, you do not have to be impressive today. Just honest.
lines.caption: honest over impressive

lines.text: Leo, the empty room is not a punishment. It is practice.
lines.caption: empty room practice

lines.text: Leo, pride said no to the lesson. Humility would have learned it faster.
lines.caption: learn it faster

lines.text: Leo, give yourself the standing ovation you keep giving others.
lines.caption: stand up for you

lines.text: Leo, loneliness gets louder when you only show the highlight reel.
lines.caption: show the bloopers

lines.text: Leo, discipline is boring, and boring is how kings are made.
lines.caption: boring builds kings

lines.text: Leo, a crown you have to keep adjusting is not a good fit.
lines.caption: wrong size crown

lines.text: Leo, nobody remembers the entrance. They remember who stayed.
lines.caption: stay for the end

lines.text: Leo, what would you build if nobody was ever going to see it?
lines.caption: build it anyway
